<question type="partial">
How do I stop people seeing that I'm typing? And can I hide it from just one person?
</question>

<expected_answer>
- Yes: turn off sending typing notifications
- Desktop/Web: gear icon, then Personal settings, then Account & privacy
- Under Privacy, toggle the settings that let recipients see when you're typing
</expected_answer>

<help_center_quotes>
- "you can configure Zulip to not send typing notifications" (https://zulip.com/help/typing-notifications, Disable sending typing notifications)
</help_center_quotes>

<answer>
Turn off typing notifications: click the gear icon, select Personal settings, then Account & privacy, and under Privacy toggle off Let recipients see when I'm typing. To hide it from just one person, mute them first.
</answer>
